2159. Finding the Number of Days in a Month Using Functions

95

Hard

Problem Statement
Read a month number and a year and print the number of days in that month, using one function that calls another function.

Description
Months 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10 and 12 have 31 days; months 4, 6, 9 and 11 have 30 days; and month 2 has 29 days in a leap year and 28 days otherwise. A year is a leap year if it is divisible by 4 but not by 100, or if it is divisible by 400. Write a function isLeapYear that takes a year and returns 1 for a leap year and 0 otherwise. Write another function daysInMonth that takes the month and year, uses a switch statement on the month, and calls isLeapYear when the month is 2. Print the result returned by daysInMonth from main().
input_spec: Two integers month and year separated by a space (1 <= month <= 12).
output_spec: Print the number of days in the given month of the given year.
